title: PaStA — the Panchromatic Stellar Atlas: catalogue construction and verification code
description:
Software that builds and verifies the Panchromatic Stellar Atlas (PaStA), a cross-match of Gaia DR3, the GALEX All-sky Imaging Survey and AllWISE giving 9,705,879 sources with photometry in twelve bands from 0.15 to 22 micron, harmonised to a single position at the Gaia reference epoch J2016.0 and to the AB magnitude system throughout.

This release accompanies Ederoclite, Camargo, Coelho & Teixeira, The Panchromatic Stellar Atlas (PaStA). I. Catalogue construction and verification, Astronomy & Astrophysics. It contains the tile queries and cross-matches that assemble the catalogue, the removal of the block-boundary duplicates, the conversion of all twelve bands to the AB system, the assignment of sources to colour-magnitude-diagram regions, the computation of the average SEDs and of the outlier flag, the scripts for every figure in the paper, the SIMBAD, Gaia-ESO and VOSA validation chain, and a verification script that recomputes every number quoted in the paper from the data products.

The catalogue itself is not part of this record; see the Data Availability section of the paper.
